build_TransresnetModel: build a TransresnetModel instance with opt, personalities list, and dictionary for image caption encoding
run_train_batch: run train_batch on the TransresnetModel with image features, personalities, and captions to compute loss
run_eval_batch: run eval_batch on the TransresnetModel to evaluate hits at 1 metrics on a batch of examples
run_choose_best_caption: run choose_best_caption to select the top k matching captions for given image features and personalities
create_LinearWrapper: create a LinearWrapper module with input dim, output dim, and dropout for a linear layer with dropout
